name: Recital 2
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 as regards obligations of economic operators concerning battery due diligence policies
part_text: (2) At a time when the geopolitical landscape continues to shift, various challenges need to be overcome, including in sourcing of raw materials. Battery manufacturers need time to analyse and, where necessary, adjust their supply chains as a result. The automotive industry is particularly under pressure due to the 2035 deadline for the internal combustion engines since that technology is expected to be replaced by batteries within electric vehicles, with binding targets for CO2 emissions set out in Regulation (EU) 2019/631 to achieve the ultimate objective of carbon neutrality by 2050. Bearing that objective in mind, Article 7 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 required the Commission to adopt by 18 February 2024 a delegated act establishing the methodology for the calculation and verification of the carbon footprint of the battery for electric vehicle batteries and an implementing act establishing the format for the carbon footprint declaration. Since the calculation and declaration should be verified by notified bodies, those bodies cannot begin their work until the necessary delegated and implementing acts are adopted.
